repairReview.subject: skills/dsh-qa/scripts/preset-register.ts + skills/dsh-qa/scripts/dual-track-smoke.ts (pre-existing test:qa red on dev)
repairReview.claim: typeof baseUrl === 'string' is a TYPE GUARD around fileURLToPath(baseUrl) (no decode, no path concat), so the old sentinel includes("typeof baseUrl") reddened on a healthy rewrite

proof.patchBlobHead: 655b8624a8e55f5e9e47c63b5fb51e3cb599f911 (cordis.patch.yml is NOT part of this wave)
proof.arithmetic: after stripping the 5 packed operands (one typeof baseUrl each), 9 typeof baseUrl occurrences remain from the guards => the OLD sentinel was necessarily TRUE on a healthy rewrite; the NEW sentinel decodeURIComponent(baseUrl) is 0 on the same rewrite

repairReview.doesItWeakenTheCheck: NO — it narrows a false-positive predicate to the packed operand's decode call, keeps both real probes (the @mpd-dsh/mpd/ leak sentinel, the MCP launcher checks, the web-compat entry check), makes the stripper quote-agnostic (double + single), and ADDS a negative control in each file so the narrowed predicate cannot become vacuous silently (if the declared patch ever loses the decode form, the self-test reddens, which is loud rather than silent)
repairReview.residualRisk: A hand-written baseUrl concat with no decodeURIComponent call would not trip the narrowed sentinel; that shape is not produced by the packer, and the @mpd-dsh/mpd/ leak sentinel still catches the packed-layout leak class. Recorded as a Nit, not a defect.
repairReview.verdict: REPAIR ACCEPTED — not a gate game

findings.what: The non-vacuity control asserts only the decode half; a future non-packer concat without decodeURIComponent would be invisible to it.
findings.whyItMatters: Only a hypothetical hand-written operand; the packed layout always carries the decode call and the @mpd-dsh/mpd/ leak sentinel still fires.
findings.direction: If desired, also assert the exact operand constants (BASEURL_RESOLVE_DQ/SQ) in the negative control — described, not applied.
